title: jired assign result
description: Result of staging an assignee change across one or more issues

assignee.description: As the files spell it: `@[Name](id)`; null when unassigning

issues.description: One entry per issue whose file was written

changed.description: False when the issue already had this assignee

differs.description: False when the edit left the file the same as the server's copy — undoing a change that was only staged — so there is nothing for push to send

staged.description: Whether the change is written in the files and waiting for `jired push`. True without `--push`, with `--dry-run`, and when the push failed.

next.description: The command that sends what is staged, when anything is.

push.description: A jired/push/1 document when --push was given
